A separate homepage widget block also links to five more per-category 'New Arrival <Category>' pages. No single sitewide aggregate New Arrivals total exists (the top-nav 'New Arrivals' link resolves to the Decorative Lighting subset only, not a superset of Home Decor/Ceiling Fans/Pendant/Outdoor), so the five verified listings are recorded as sibling rows under category 'New Arrivals' rather than a fabricated parent/child grouping -- some product overlap between the Decorative Lighting row and the Pendant Lights/Outdoor Lights rows is plausible (Pendant/Outdoor are lighting sub-types) but could not be confirmed from the SSR HTML (the product grid itself is client-hydrated via GraphQL; only the toolbar count is server-rendered), and per the brief this overlap is expected, not an error.
